en.text: After this Job opened his mouth, and cursed the day of his birth.

zhSimplified.text: 此后，约伯开口咒诅自己的生日，

zhTraditional.text: 此後，約伯開口咒詛自己的生日，

en.text: Job answered:

zhSimplified.text: 说：

zhTraditional.text: 說：

en.text: “Let the day perish in which I was born, the night which said, ‘There is a boy conceived.’

zhSimplified.text: 愿我生的那日 和说怀了男胎的那夜都灭没。

zhTraditional.text: 願我生的那日 和說懷了男胎的那夜都滅沒。

en.text: Let that day be darkness. Don’t let God from above seek for it, neither let the light shine on it.

zhSimplified.text: 愿那日变为黑暗； 愿 神不从上面寻找它； 愿亮光不照于其上。

zhTraditional.text: 願那日變為黑暗； 願上帝不從上面尋找它； 願亮光不照於其上。

en.text: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own. Let a cloud dwell on it. Let all that makes the day black terrify it.

zhSimplified.text: 愿黑暗和死荫索取那日； 愿密云停在其上； 愿日蚀恐吓它。

zhTraditional.text: 願黑暗和死蔭索取那日； 願密雲停在其上； 願日蝕恐嚇它。

en.text: As for that night, let thick darkness seize on it. Let it not rejoice among the days of the year. Let it not come into the number of the months.

zhSimplified.text: 愿那夜被幽暗夺取， 不在年中的日子同乐， 也不入月中的数目。

zhTraditional.text: 願那夜被幽暗奪取， 不在年中的日子同樂， 也不入月中的數目。

en.text: Behold, let that night be barren. Let no joyful voice come therein.

zhSimplified.text: 愿那夜没有生育， 其间也没有欢乐的声音。

zhTraditional.text: 願那夜沒有生育， 其間也沒有歡樂的聲音。

en.text: Let them curse it who curse the day, who are ready to rouse up leviathan.

zhSimplified.text: 愿那咒诅日子且能惹动鳄鱼的 咒诅那夜。

zhTraditional.text: 願那咒詛日子且能惹動鱷魚的 咒詛那夜。

en.text: Let the stars of its twilight be dark. Let it look for light, but have none, neither let it see the eyelids of the morning,

zhSimplified.text: 愿那夜黎明的星宿变为黑暗， 盼亮却不亮， 也不见早晨的光线；

zhTraditional.text: 願那夜黎明的星宿變為黑暗， 盼亮卻不亮， 也不見早晨的光線；

en.text: because it didn’t shut up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor did it hide trouble from my eyes.

zhSimplified.text: 因没有把怀我胎的门关闭， 也没有将患难对我的眼隐藏。

zhTraditional.text: 因沒有把懷我胎的門關閉， 也沒有將患難對我的眼隱藏。

en.text: “Why didn’t I die from the womb? Why didn’t I give up the spirit when my mother bore me?

zhSimplified.text: 我为何不出母胎而死？ 为何不出母腹绝气？

zhTraditional.text: 我為何不出母胎而死？ 為何不出母腹絕氣？

en.text: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should nurse?

zhSimplified.text: 为何有膝接收我？ 为何有奶哺养我？

zhTraditional.text: 為何有膝接收我？ 為何有奶哺養我？

en.text: For now I should have lain down and been quiet. I should have slept, then I would have been at rest,

zhSimplified.text: 不然，我就早已躺卧安睡，

zhTraditional.text: 不然，我就早已躺臥安睡，

en.text: with kings and counselors of the earth, who built up waste places for themselves;

zhSimplified.text: 和地上为自己重造荒邱的君王、谋士，

zhTraditional.text: 和地上為自己重造荒邱的君王、謀士，

en.text: or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver;

zhSimplified.text: 或与有金子、将银子装满了房屋的王子 一同安息；

zhTraditional.text: 或與有金子、將銀子裝滿了房屋的王子 一同安息；

en.text: or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light.

zhSimplified.text: 或像隐而未现、不到期而落的胎， 归于无有，如同未见光的婴孩。

zhTraditional.text: 或像隱而未現、不到期而落的胎， 歸於無有，如同未見光的嬰孩。

en.text: There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.

zhSimplified.text: 在那里恶人止息搅扰， 困乏人得享安息，

zhTraditional.text: 在那裏惡人止息攪擾， 困乏人得享安息，

en.text: There the prisoners are at ease together. They don’t hear the voice of the taskmaster.

zhSimplified.text: 被囚的人同得安逸， 不听见督工的声音。

zhTraditional.text: 被囚的人同得安逸， 不聽見督工的聲音。

en.text: The small and the great are there. The servant is free from his master.

zhSimplified.text: 大小都在那里； 奴仆脱离主人的辖制。

zhTraditional.text: 大小都在那裏； 奴僕脫離主人的轄制。

en.text: “Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,

zhSimplified.text: 受患难的人为何有光赐给他呢？ 心中愁苦的人为何有生命赐给他呢？

zhTraditional.text: 受患難的人為何有光賜給他呢？ 心中愁苦的人為何有生命賜給他呢？

en.text: who long for death, but it doesn’t come; and dig for it more than for hidden treasures,

zhSimplified.text: 他们切望死，却不得死； 求死，胜于求隐藏的珍宝。

zhTraditional.text: 他們切望死，卻不得死； 求死，勝於求隱藏的珍寶。

en.text: who rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?

zhSimplified.text: 他们寻见坟墓就快乐， 极其欢喜。

zhTraditional.text: 他們尋見墳墓就快樂， 極其歡喜。

en.text: Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?

zhSimplified.text: 人的道路既然遮隐， 神又把他四面围困， 为何有光赐给他呢？

zhTraditional.text: 人的道路既然遮隱， 上帝又把他四面圍困， 為何有光賜給他呢？

en.text: For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water.

zhSimplified.text: 我未曾吃饭就发出叹息； 我唉哼的声音涌出如水。

zhTraditional.text: 我未曾吃飯就發出歎息； 我唉哼的聲音湧出如水。

en.text: For the thing which I fear comes on me, that which I am afraid of comes to me.

zhSimplified.text: 因我所恐惧的临到我身， 我所惧怕的迎我而来。

zhTraditional.text: 因我所恐懼的臨到我身， 我所懼怕的迎我而來。

en.text: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither do I have rest; but trouble comes.”

zhSimplified.text: 我不得安逸，不得平静， 也不得安息，却有患难来到。

zhTraditional.text: 我不得安逸，不得平靜， 也不得安息，卻有患難來到。
